stem.text: Limonene is found in lemon and orange oils.

stem.alt: Skeletal formula of limonene, labelled limonene: a cyclohexene ring with a ring C=C double bond, a methyl group on the upper carbon, and an isopropenyl group (a C=CH2 double bond on a methyl-bearing carbon) on the lower carbon.

stem.text: What is the major product when limonene reacts with an excess of dry hydrogen chloride?

A.alt: Skeletal formula: cyclohexane ring with a Cl atom on the top carbon and an isopropenyl group below the ring.

B.alt: Skeletal formula: cyclohexane ring with a Cl atom on the upper right carbon and an isopropenyl group below the ring.

C.alt: Skeletal formula: cyclohexane ring with a Cl atom on the top carbon and a second Cl atom on the bottom carbon, which carries a methyl group.

D.alt: Skeletal formula: cyclohexane ring with a Cl atom on the upper right carbon, and a chain on the bottom carbon ending in a second Cl atom.
